card.name: Punctuation inside numeric ranges and tables
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spacing right after a number or measurement label, where a list of values, a unit conversion or a threshold comes next. Seen in lab grading tables, storage temperatures and visual acuity.

modes.label: Comma or colon in value lists
modes.description: A comma or colon after a number or category label that introduces the next value in a list or table.
modes.example: Normal: greater than or equal to 90<<,>> Mild: 60 to less than

modes.label: Bracket or slash after a measure
modes.description: A parenthesis, space or slash after a measurement, just before a converted or paired value.

card.plain: It marks the small break after a number where the next value in a table or range is about to start.
